transcript:
DAVID: Huh? (Remembering) Oh yeah. (Clears throat).

DAVID (presenter voice): I'm now walking towards the infamous east wing. 

[SFX: a couple more footsteps]

DAVID (CONT'D): The fire burnt this area of the asylum pretty bad. Most of the roof has collapsed inward. As you can hear, it’s still raining outside. Raining inside this room, too.

[SFX: We hear David stop walking and sniff at the air.]

DAVID (confused, transition to normal voice): I can smell smoke...

[DAVID sniffs some more]

DAVID (CONT’D): Oh no. 

MARTIN: What?

DAVID: It's the freaking flashlight. I charged the phone, but I forgot the goddamn batteries in the flashlight.   


[IDLE LOOP: David clicking the flashlight; shaking it; banging it to try get more juice out of it]
